label: Local source cache source-access policy

mode_meanings.committed_fixture_only: Use synthetic or reviewed committed fixture records only.
mode_meanings.repo_local_only: Use repo-local committed metadata and governance files only.
mode_meanings.manual_human_only: Allow a human to describe a source posture without automated access.
mode_meanings.approved_metadata_probe_future: Future metadata-only probe after explicit source policy and operator approval.
mode_meanings.approved_api_future: Future approved API use after source policy, credentials, terms, and rate review.
mode_meanings.approved_static_dump_future: Future approved static dump intake after provenance and privacy review.
mode_meanings.approved_common_crawl_or_archive_future: Future archive/dump use after policy, robots/terms, and rate review.
mode_meanings.permission_needed: Access is blocked until source permission and policy review are complete.
mode_meanings.robots_blocked: Access is blocked by robots or automated-access review.
mode_meanings.terms_blocked: Access is blocked by terms or source policy review.
mode_meanings.restricted_demand_signal_only: Only aggregate, privacy-filtered demand signal may be retained after review.
mode_meanings.no_autonomous_access: No autonomous source access is allowed.

notes: No current plan may enable live probes, source sync, scraping, crawling, arbitrary URL fetch, API calls, downloads, uploads, or execution.
Future modes are vocabulary only until separate reviewed tasks provide source policy and runtime implementation.
